long_description: Native Nintendo 3DS port of Mario Kart 64, based on SpaghettiKart
preinstall_message: This game is mainly intended for New Nintendo 3DS systems.  After installation, place your Mario Kart 64 ROM in: sd:/3ds/MK64/  For a faster setup, generate `mk64.o2r` using SpaghettiKart on a computer and place it in the same folder.
